title: Izilungiselelo
subtitle: Buyekeza ulwazi lwesitolo sakho
compliance_desc: Uma umhloli wezempilo evakashela isitolo sakho, mbonise le-PDF. Inohlu lwakho lwesitokhu sonke, izinsuku zokuphelelwa, nezinsuku ezingu-30 zokuthengisa — konke abakudingayo.
hint_reg_number: Inombolo yakho yokubhalisa ye-CIPC noma kamasipala. Ibonakala emibikweni yokulandela imithetho.
placeholder_location: isb. 12 Main Rd, Khayelitsha, Cape Town
hint_location: Ikheli lesitolo sakho. Libonakala emibikweni yokulandela imithetho.
label_threshold: Ngazise uma umkhiqizo usale nangaphansi kwe-
data_desc: Landa ikhophi yakho konke i-Movestock egcina ngesitolo sakho — imikhiqizo yakho, ukuthengisa, abasebenzi, abahlinzeki kanye nokuhlolwa kwansuku zonke. I-POPIA, umthetho wedatha waseNingizimu Afrika, ukunika ilungelo lokuthola ikhophi yedatha yakho noma nini.
data_error: Asikwazanga ukukhipha idatha yakho. Sicela uzame futhi.
danger_desc: Susa unomphela isitolo sakho nakho konke okukuso — imikhiqizo, ukuthengisa, abasebenzi nemibiko. Lokhu akunakubuyiselwa.
danger_confirm: Lokhu kususa unomphela isitolo sakho nakho konke okukuso. Ungabhalisa futhi kamuva ngolwazi lokungena olufanayo. Uqinisekile?
danger_error: Ayikwazanga ukususa i-akhawunti yakho. Sicela uzame futhi.
profit_tracking_desc: Bona ukuthi ungakanani inzuzo oyenzayo nsuku zonke. Udinga ukufaka intengo yokubiza kumkhiqizo ngamunye.
subscribe_trial_days_left_one: Usele nosuku olungu-{count} esilingweni sakho samahhala.
subscribe_trial_days_left_other: Usele nezinsuku ezingu-{count} esilingweni sakho samahhala.
subscribe_payment_methods: Khokha ngekhadi, i-EFT noma i-SnapScan nge-PayFast
subscribe_method_eft_desc: Ukudluliswa kwemali kwebhange ngesandla. Iyavulwa zingakapheli izinsuku zomsebenzi ezi-1 emva kokuthi sibone inkokhelo yakho.
subscribe_method_payfast_desc: Ikhadi, i-EFT esheshayo noma i-SnapScan. Iyazivuselela ngokuzenzakalelayo njalo ngenyanga.
subscribe_payment_safety: Inkokhelo yakho icutshungulwa yi-PayFast noma ibhange lakho. Asikaze siyibone noma sigcine imininingwane yekhadi lakho.
eft_page_subtitle: Dlulisela u-R{amount} ebhange lakho uye kwelethu.
eft_warning_body: Ngaphandle kwekhodi yesitolo sakho njengenkomba yenkokhelo, ngeke sikwazi ukufanisa imali yakho futhi isitolo sakho ngeke sivulwe.
eft_reference_hint: Yibhale kahle nje — yikhodi yesitolo sakho.
eft_bank_not_configured: Imininingwane yebhange ayikabekwa. Sicela uthumele i-WhatsApp ukucela usizo.
eft_after_pay_body: Sihlola i-akhawunti yethu yasebhange kanye ngosuku ngezinsuku zomsebenzi. Lapho sibona imali yakho ifika nekhodi yesitolo sakho njengenkomba, siyasivula isitolo sakho. Lokhu kuvame ukuthatha usuku olu-1 lomsebenzi.
eft_load_error_body: Sicela uhlole i-inthanethi yakho uzame futhi.
subscribe_success_desc: Okubhalisile kwakho manje kuyasebenza. Unokufinyelela okugcwele ku-Movestock.
subscribe_error_connect: Ayikwazanga ukuxhuma. Sicela uhlole i-inthanethi yakho uzame futhi.
fund_interest_help: Show the Spaza Shop Support Fund eligibility checker on your dashboard.
